media_work.title: In the Shadow of Justice (Dateline NBC)

media_item.item_title: In the Shadow of Justice: The Confession
media_item.summary_notes: This Dateline NBC episode focuses on the case of Daniel Villegas, who confessed as a teenager to a double murder he maintained he didn't commit. He was eventually acquitted after years of effort by supporters.

research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Title suggests exploration of a potential wrongful conviction case; list notes further research needed. Available via NBC/Peacock.
research_notes_other.research_findings: "In the Shadow of Justice" appears to be a recurring theme or title prefix for Dateline episodes focusing on potential miscarriages of justice. One specific episode identified is "In the Shadow of Justice: The Confession" (Oct 2015) featuring Daniel Villegas, who confessed as a teenager to a double murder he maintained he didn't commit and was eventually acquitted after years of effort by supporters. Another episode under this banner is "A Bronx Tale" (Entry 4.10).

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Daniel Villegas confessed at age 16 to a double murder he maintained he didn't commit. He was wrongfully convicted and served over 18 years before his conviction was overturned and he was acquitted at retrial.
organizations_involved_raw: Supporter John Mimbella heavily involved in freeing him
